title: OmpWorkerBenchmarkResult
description: Schema for recording reproducible OMP Worker benchmark execution runs across Direct and Supervisor-Worker modes.

$schema.description: Optional URI or local path reference to this JSON schema.

task_id.description: Unique run or trial identifier assigned by the operator.

model_identifier.description: Identifier of primary host model and/or worker model (e.g., 'claude-3-7-sonnet', 'gemini-3.7-flash').

client_identifier.description: Name of host client or harness (e.g., 'codex', 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'workbuddy').

client_version.description: Exact version, build, or release identifier of the host client/harness.

wall_clock_seconds.description: Elapsed time from prompt submission / delegation to final outcome in seconds.

primary_harness_tool_calls.description: Number of tool calls directly invoked by the primary host harness during the task. Set to null if unobservable.

acceptance_result.description: Independent evaluation of whether the deliverables satisfied the acceptance criteria.

retry_count.description: Number of corrective iterations or omp_continue cycles executed to achieve the result.

available.description: Flag indicating whether reliable token consumption telemetry was observed from the client/host.

telemetry_source.description: Name or description of the client-provided usage view, session export, or telemetry surface (e.g., 'codex_session_jsonl', 'codex-cli-session-export', 'account-usage-dashboard'). Required when token telemetry is available; null when unobservable.

input_tokens.description: Directly observed prompt/input tokens, or null if telemetry is unavailable.

output_tokens.description: Directly observed completion/output tokens, or null if telemetry is unavailable.

total_tokens.description: Directly observed total tokens, or null if telemetry is unavailable.

disclosure.description: Mandatory statement explaining how token telemetry was captured or the reason for unobservability.

available.description: Flag indicating whether exact per-session monetary cost was directly provided by the host client/platform.

total_cost_usd.description: Directly observed cost in USD, or null if unexposed or operating under subscription/quota tiers. Must not be estimated or inferred from token counts or plan fees.

disclosure.description: Mandatory statement explaining cost telemetry availability or reasons for unobservability (e.g., subscription tier without per-session dollar breakdown).

notes.description: Qualitative observations regarding context retention, tool overhead, failure recovery, or workflow smoothness.
